title: OMG, it's a Chickens!
description: 17 colorful chicken breeds, breeding system, fried egg portal, custom dimension, rideable giant chicken mounts that walk on lava and glide, CS:GO-style roulette, and more!
body:
OMG, it's a Chickens!
A complete chicken adventure — from hatching your first chick to riding a giant chicken across lava!

🐔 What is this mod?
Ever wished Minecraft chickens were more than just feather factories? This mod adds 17 colorful chicken breeds, a full genetics and breeding system, a custom dimension, rideable giant chicken mounts, and a CS:GO-style daily roulette — all completable in early game with zero dependencies.

✨ Features
🎨 Colorful Chickens (3 Tiers)

Tier 1 — 8 basic colors spawn naturally: White, Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Purple, Black
Tier 2 — Breed two Tier 1 chickens to discover: Pink, Teal, Golden Brown, Gray, Copper, Emerald
Tier 3 — Breed two Tier 2 chickens for the rarest: Silver, Ruby, Platinum
Each chicken drops colored feathers and colored eggs

🏠 Chicken Coops

Small hen houses generate naturally in plains, forests, meadows, and birch forests
Each coop contains chickens and a Chicken Guide book to get you started

🥚 The Golden Egg & Portal

Craft the Golden Egg from Tier 2 feathers and Tier 3 eggs
Throw it to create a fried egg portal (yes, really — a 2×2 yolk + egg white!)
Step on the yolk to get slowly pulled in... or jump to escape!

🏝️ The Golden Dimension

A beautiful island with mountains, a tavern, paths, flowers, and a pond
Two giant faction chickens await — Light and Dark
Throw feathers at your chosen faction to earn their trust
Collect 50 feathers to win your very own rideable mount!

🐓 Rideable Mounts

Light Chicken — Super high jump + glide through the air!
Dark Chicken — Walks on lava like a Strider + glide!
Both mounts travel through Nether portals with you
Mount inventory: carry items on the chicken's back
Craft a Feather Backpack (8 feathers + chest) for 6 extra inventory slots
Make your chicken sit with Shift+Right-click

🎰 Kurletka (Daily Roulette)

Find the Kurletka block in the Golden Dimension tavern
CS:GO-style spinning card roulette!
Win buff cards: Speed, Strength, Luck, Resistance, Jump Boost, Night Vision, Haste
Also win Mystery Chests with random loot

📖 In-Game Guidebook

Complete guide covering all mechanics — breeding charts, crafting recipes, faction info
Found in chicken coops or craftable


📋 Details

Minecraft Version: 1.20.1
Mod Loader: Forge
Dependencies: None — fully standalone!
Completable: Early to mid game
Multiplayer: Fully supported — per-player faction system


🎮 Quick Start

Find colored chickens in the wild
Breed them to discover new colors (check the Chicken Guide book!)
Collect Tier 2 and Tier 3 feathers
Craft the Golden Egg and throw it to create a portal
Enter the Golden Dimension and choose your faction
Earn your rideable chicken mount!
